targets.expr:
max(otelcol_process_uptime${suffix_seconds}${suffix_total}{"service${divider:raw}instance${divider:raw}id"=~".*",job="$job","service${divider:raw}version"=".+"}) by ("service${divider:raw}instance${divider:raw}id","service${divider:raw}name","service${divider:raw}version")
or
max(
  otelcol_process_uptime${suffix_seconds}${suffix_total}{"service${divider:raw}instance${divider:raw}id"=~".*",job="$job"} 
  * on(job, instance) 
  group_left("service${divider:raw}version") 
  (
    target_info 
    * on(job, instance) 
    group_left 
    label_replace(target_info{}, "service${divider:raw}instance${divider:raw}id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")
  )
) by ("service${divider:raw}instance${divider:raw}id", "service${divider:raw}name", "service${divider:raw}version")

panels.description: Receivers -> Processor(s) -> Exporters (Node Graph panel is beta, so this panel may not show data correctly).

targets.expr:
# receivers
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      sum(${metric:value}(
        otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans${suffix_total}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
      ) by (receiver)
      , "id", "-rcv-", "transport", "receiver"
    )
    , "title", "", "transport", "receiver"
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-to-right", "", ""
)

# dummy processor
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      (sum(rate(otelcol_process_uptime${suffix_seconds}${suffix_total}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))
      , "id", "processor", "", ""
    )
    , "title", "Processor(s)", "", ""
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-random", "", ""
)

# exporters
or
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      sum(${metric:value}(
        otelcol_exporter_sent_spans${suffix_total}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
      ) by (exporter)
      , "id", "-exp-", "transport", "exporter"
    )
    , "title", "", "transport", "exporter"
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-from-right", "", ""
)

# receivers -> processor
label_join(
    label_replace(
        label_join(
            (sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans${suffix_total}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) by (receiver))
            ,"source", "-rcv-", "transport", "receiver"
        )
        ,"target", "processor", "", ""
    )
    , "id", "-", "source", "target"
)

# processor -> exporters
or
label_join(
    label_replace(
        label_join(
            (sum(rate(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans${suffix_total}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) by (exporter))
            , "target", "-exp-", "transport", "exporter"
        )
        , "source", "processor", "", ""
    )
    , "id", "-", "source", "target"
)
